mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post_comment (comment_id, post_id, user_id, content, state, root_id, parent_id, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{commentId}, #{postId}, #{userId}, #{content}, #{state}, #{rootId}, #{parentId}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM post_comment c
WHERE c.comment_id IN #{commentId} AND c.root_id = '0' AND c.state = 'NORMAL'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_comment WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND root_id = '0' AND state = 'NORMAL'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_comment WHERE root_id = #{rootId} AND state = 'NORMAL'
mapper.update: UPDATE post_comment SET reply_count = GREATEST(0, reply_count + #{delta}), update_time = NOW() WHERE comment_id = #{rootId}
mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.comment_id, c.post_id, c.user_id, c.content, c.state, c.root_id, c.parent_id, c.reply_count, c.create_time, c.update_time, p.title AS post_title, p.cover AS post_cover FROM post_comment c JOIN post p ON c.post_id = p.post_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.state = 'NORMAL' AND p.state = 'NORMAL' ORDER BY c.create_time DESC, c.comment_id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM post_comment c JOIN post p ON c.post_id = p.post_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.state = 'NORMAL' AND p.state = 'NORMAL'
